name: blueprint/data-adapter
description: Wrap one keyless public API as a righthand tool family: guarded fetch (SSRF checklist), normalize to a stable shape, one tool per query. Weather (Open-Meteo) is the worked example, shipped as src/weather-tools.ts.
recipe: probe the endpoint live -> fixture from the real response -> normalize to a stable shape -> one tool per query, all through guardedFetch -> optional rh_store TTL cache
cost_hint: free (keyless endpoints; caching reduces repeat calls)
pitfalls: probe the endpoint before writing the normalizer (wire shape drifts)
fixture-test the normalizer against a REAL captured response
SSRF checklist: public destinations only, revalidate every redirect hop, cap size + time
DNS answers can mix public and private records - block if ANY address is private
a keyless API can still rate-limit; cache before you retry
never put an API token in the adapter - a key requirement puts the service out of scope
local_limits: only endpoints reachable from the user's machine; no server-side cache between sessions
cloud_limits: same endpoints via the user's own Cloudflare account; Workers egress to keyless APIs is free for most
